Download **Geronimo-Setup-win-x64.exe** for one Windows 10/11 x64 installer. It includes the dashboard, native overlay, .NET runtime and PresentMon frame collector, and offers the official PawnIO sensor driver setup. Keep that driver task selected and complete its setup window. WebView2 setup needs internet if the shared Microsoft runtime is missing. Installer requires Windows administrator approval. Geronimo's own preview installer is unsigned.

This fixes an omitted prerequisite in the earlier preview: LibreHardwareMonitor needs PawnIO 2.0+ for CPU registers and RAM/motherboard access. Failed Ryzen temperature reads now show unavailable rather than 0°C. Overview/Hardware explain the driver and elevation state and provide setup/restart buttons. Live DIMM temperatures are kept separate from SPD limit/resolution metadata; each exposed module and motherboard/storage temperature is listed.

Overlay Studio now selects/reorders up to 24 readings, with text/background colors, size, opacity, layouts and click-through: CPU/GPU/RAM, individual temperatures/usage/clocks/power, process name/CPU/RAM, FPS, frame time and network ping. Choose a running process for PresentMon capture, and choose a host for ICMP ping. FPS is application present rate on the busiest swap chain, averaged over two seconds; frame time is between presents, not input latency. Ping is host round-trip time, not automatically in-game latency. Administrator access may be required for ETW/hardware access. Ctrl+Shift+O toggles the native overlay; windowed/borderless apps are supported by design, exclusive-fullscreen compatibility is not guaranteed.

Hardware and sensor support depends on the provider, board, firmware and driver. Automatic detection cannot guarantee all processors/DIMMs. Missing/invalid sensors and idle/blocked measurements remain unavailable. Actual readings on Ryzen 7 5700X/ASRock B550M Pro4/G.Skill DIMMs still need verification on the user's PC.

Portable alternatives: extract the **entire** Geronimo-windows-win-x64.zip, keeping DLLs/Assets/Tools beside Geronimo.exe. The slim ZIP additionally requires the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime; both portable packages need WebView2 and PawnIO installed for full functionality. Shared PawnIO/WebView2 installations are not removed when uninstalling Geronimo.

Validation: automated UI/native-contract tests, sensor-policy/frame-parser regression checks, Windows compilation/packaging, pinned component hashes and driver/bootstrapper signature verification. Real hardware readings, ETW capture, installer component setup/UAC and Windows resource use require real-PC validation. Corresponding PawnIO driver sources and component license notices are included in Tools.
